propositions: push_tickets_branch must perform exactly five in-loop push→fetch→merge cycles followed by one terminal sixth push only when the fifth rejection produces a clean merge, matching the shipped workflow max_retries=5 plus final push behavior

strict=False (default) preserves all existing caller contracts returning normally; strict=True raises catchable PushDeliveryError with one of ten pinned machine-stable reasons (push-disabled, async-delivery-unobservable, invalid-destination, remote-not-found, push-policy-declined, push-transport-failed, merge-recovery-blocked, store-epoch-pre-merge, store-epoch-during-recovery, final-push-rejected, lock-timeout) plus underlying git detail and unpushed commit count

the private module CLI boundary python -m rebar._store.push push --strict alone catches PushDeliveryError, emits stderr message, and returns nonzero; no strict-specific code path writes events or BRIDGE_ALERT

all existing push callers (event append, batch append, NDJSON import, transition close, delete, compact, compact-all, claim) omit strict argument or reach core with strict=False and inherit only the five-cycle plus terminal-push durability correction while retaining legacy return/disposition contracts

policy-decline terminal rejections map to push-policy-declined; timeout/network/transport failures map to push-transport-failed; rebase/merge recovery, both store-epoch guards, final-push exhaustion, lock timeout, sync.push=off/async, malformed destination, and missing remote each map to distinct pinned reasons
